title: Role-to-stage enforcement in run engine
description: Add runtime role enforcement to the run engine. Each stage in STAGE_CONFIG declares which role owns it. Before an artifact can be written to a stage directory, the engine must verify that the requesting agent's role matches the stage's declared role. If the role does not match, the engine must reject the submission with a clear error. This prevents cross-role leakage where e.g. a DEV agent produces QA artifacts.
stop_condition: A role cannot execute a stage it does not own. The run engine rejects artifact submissions from the wrong role with a JSON error.
